scope: One adaptive canonical Huffman prefix primitive; two frozen JPEG inputs from one original 513x259 raster. Single CPU warm public decode to independent RGBA8. No uniform parity claim.
changedPrimitive: Keep the existing eight-bit lookup. Only tables containing nine/ten-bit codes allocate an additional input-derived ten-bit lookup for those codes. Admit 2048 payload bytes/1024 construction units per such table. Each symbol retains original code-bit work; cached padding, markers, truncation and tight limits keep scalar failure precedence and required-byte positions. Other code lengths use the existing scalar reader.

baseline.boundary: Identical resident prepared 8-bit 4:4:4 JPEG to independent owned RGBA8. Public managed Decode, allocation and disposal; native software mjpeg decoder, per-operation state reset, full-range BT.601 conversion, owned output allocation and release. Native context/conversion/input packet/frame wrappers reused; every call decodes and converts all pixels. Padded native rows are exposed without a gratuitous packing copy. Startup, I/O, IPC, generation, hashing, checks and tight-row file writes excluded. No encoder quality search or additional source raster. Decoder RGB maximum 4/RMSE 1.5, exact opaque alpha.

uncertainty: Two independent three-sample screens guide ranking. Conservative upper uses managed 99.9% Student-t upper mean divided by the smaller native bracket lower mean with the same critical value. Failed post-run rolling-load samples remain; later quiet checks do not prove hypervisor isolation. The owned affected input has one screen only, not a new confirmation. Native-input mean spread is retained separately; the earlier baseline spread is not discarded.
